About this item

[Unique Style & Safety Features] - This electric bike for adults stands out with its distinctive design and stylish bike headlight for nighttime safety. The saddle provides a delicate and soft feel, while the strengthened pole and hollowed-out bracket enhance the sports adventure experience. Be the envy of others and embrace the latest fashion trend.
[Powerful 1000W Motor & 20''x4.0 Fat Tires] - Conquer any terrain with ease using the e-bike's powerful 1000W brushless motor, reaching speeds up to 28+++mph and tackling slopes up to 35°. The 20''x4.0 fat tires are suitable for snow, beach, mountains, and city roads. Enjoy precise gear shifting with the professional Shamano 7-speed system.
[3 Riding Modes & Extended Range] - Choose between pure electric, electric assist, and pedal modes for versatile riding options. The removable 48V 15AH lithium-ion battery provides a range of up to 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. The UL-certified battery includes BMS security protection and offers fast charging in 4-6 hours.
[Enhanced Suspension & Mechanical Disc Brake] - The reinforced front suspension fork makes it easy to handle rough terrain. The rear-mounted hydraulic shock absorber delivers excellent performance. The mechanical disc brake system ensures your riding safety.

[User-Friendly Display & Enhanced Safety] - Stay informed with the advanced LCD display, providing real-time metrics, adjustable parameters, and trip-tracking options. Bright LED headlights and IP5 waterproof protection ensure safe riding in diverse road conditions. The electric dirt bike for adults has a maximum load capacity of 330 lbs
[Convenient Features & Accessories] - The electric mountain bike includes a 7.2'' phone holder and a spacious storage box. It features a multi-function LCD display, high brightness front light, and tail light for enhanced safety.
[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 1-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. Feel free to reach out for any inquiries, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

Disc brakes and reflectors ensure riding safety.
Our electric bike comes equipped with high-quality front and rear disc brakes, providing powerful and agile braking performance in all road conditions. Additionally, our mechanical disc brake system ensures your safety while riding. The front wheel quick release design also makes installation and carrying more convenient. With added bike reflectors for night riding, you can ride with confidence and peace of mind.

Illuminate Your Path with High-Quality Headlights
Our electric bike features high-quality circular headlights that provide long-distance illumination, ensuring your safety during night rides. With the ability to light up your surroundings, our headlights offer added visibility and peace of mind. Ride with confidence and safety, even in low-light conditions, with our top-of-the-line electric bike headlights.

Enjoy a Smooth Riding Experience
Our electric bike offers a smooth and comfortable riding experience with its advanced suspension system and front and rear shock absorbers. Designed to handle rough terrain with ease, our bike ensures that every ride is enjoyable and effortless. Say goodbye to bumpy rides and hello to a smooth and comfortable journey with our electric bike.

Extended Range with Removable 48V Battery
Our electric bike comes equipped with a powerful 48V 15.6Ah lithium battery with a key lock attached to the frame, offering an extended range for your ride. With the convenience of charging the battery on or off the bike, you can easily maintain your power source according to your needs. It takes only 5-6 hours to fully charge, and the battery will last you an impressive 25-50 miles, depending on your riding style and weight.

Convenient Phone Holder and Storage Bag
Our electric bike comes equipped with a phone holder and storage bag, providing convenience and practicality for your ride. The phone holder allows you to easily access your phone while riding, making it easy to navigate and stay connected. The storage bag provides ample space to store your personal belongings, such as keys, wallet, and snacks, ensuring that you have everything you need within easy reach.

Waterproof LCD Display
Our electric bike features a waterproof LCD display that allows you to easily access important information about your ride. With this display, you can easily monitor your battery power, speed, speed modes, and total mileage, ensuring that you have all the information you need at your fingertips. The display is designed to be durable and waterproof, providing a clear view of your ride information even in wet conditions.

Customize Your Riding Performance with Shimano 7-Speed
Our electric bike is equipped with Shimano 7-speed, allowing you to customize your riding performance to suit your needs. With a wider range of gears available, you can achieve greater torque for challenging uphill climbs and maintain pedal authority at top speeds. The gears are nickel-plated for rust resistance and smooth shifting, ensuring a smooth and reliable ride.

Powerful 1000W High-Speed Motor
Our electric mountain bike is equipped with a powerful 1000W high-speed brushless motor, providing greater power and torque for your ride. With a top speed of up to 28+++mph, you can easily tackle challenging terrain and reach your destination faster.
